description: RC2.3.9 — gates or executions removed from the critical path, each with proof that its invariants stay covered. A gate without equivalence is never retired (it keeps running). Historical reports, migration evidence, fingerprint history and incident history are never deleted.

executionDedupes.what: Identical leaf commands reached more than once through nested gates inside the legacy validate:beta chain (typecheck ×6, validate:beta-pedagogy-freeze ×5, Android foundation/signing/boundary/play/tts/conversation-transition ×2, rc230-self-compare ×2).
executionDedupes.equivalenceEvidence: Same command string, same checkout, no file under src/ written in between: the canonical runner executes the first occurrence and skips later identical commands within one invocation (scripts/run-canonical-beta-gates.mjs, dedupe by exact command).
executionDedupes.mutationParity: Unchanged — the mutation scripts are the same commands; each still runs once.

executionDedupes.what: .github/workflows/android-build.yml re-ran the 26 Android/RC2.2 wave gates that validate:beta (suite android-native) already runs on the same events (pull_request, push main).
executionDedupes.equivalenceEvidence: Identical npm scripts executed by ci.yml suite `android-native` on pull_request and push to main; android-build.yml keeps them only for workflow_dispatch (manual runs, where ci.yml does not trigger).
executionDedupes.mutationParity: Unchanged — same scripts, now executed once per commit.
